purpose: Reject duplicate Institute ID on creation.
preconditions: A user with Institute ID I-100 exists.
action_or_input: Create another user with Institute ID I-100.
expected_result: Creation is rejected.

purpose: Reject changes to an existing Institute ID.
preconditions: A user with Institute ID I-100 exists.
action_or_input: Update the user's Institute ID to I-101.
expected_result: Update is rejected and the Institute ID remains I-100.

purpose: Reject an invalid institute email.
action_or_input: Create or update a basic-user account with an invalid institute email address.
expected_result: The operation is rejected.

purpose: Reject Student records missing valid program or batch information.
action_or_input: Submit a Student record missing or containing invalid program or batch information.
expected_result: Record is rejected and missing or invalid fields are reported.

source_id: BR-SA-003 Faculty and Staff required data
purpose: Reject Faculty or Staff records missing valid employee ID or department.
action_or_input: Submit an incomplete Faculty or Staff record.
expected_result: Record is rejected and missing or invalid fields are reported.

purpose: Reject records missing common mandatory data.
action_or_input: Submit a user record with a common mandatory field omitted.
expected_result: Record is rejected and the missing field is reported.

purpose: Allow archival when every eligibility condition holds.
preconditions: User is deactivated; configured minimum interval elapsed; no pending transactions.
action_or_input: Submit an archival request.
expected_result: Archival is allowed.

purpose: Reject archival when an eligibility condition fails.
preconditions: User is active, or interval has not elapsed, or pending transactions remain unresolved.
action_or_input: Submit an archival request.
expected_result: Archival is rejected with a reason.

source_id: BR-SA-005 restoration within reversible period with authorization
purpose: Allow authorized restoration within the configured reversible period.
preconditions: User is archived; reversible period has not expired; required authorization is present.
action_or_input: Submit a restoration request.
expected_result: Restoration is permitted.

source_id: BR-SA-005 restoration within reversible period without authorization
purpose: Reject restoration without required authorization.
preconditions: User is archived; reversible period has not expired; authorization is absent.
action_or_input: Submit a restoration request.
expected_result: Restoration is rejected.

purpose: Enforce permanent non-restorability after the configured period expires.
preconditions: User is archived; reversible period has expired.
action_or_input: Submit a restoration request with authorization.
expected_result: Request is rejected and account remains permanently archived and non-restorable.

purpose: Allow multiple additional roles unless another rule invalidates the combination.
preconditions: User holds another role; proposed combination violates no other rule.
action_or_input: Assign another additional role.
expected_result: Assignment is not rejected merely because another role exists.

source_id: BR-SA-007 singular role overlapping second holder
purpose: Reject overlapping active holders of a singular role in the same scope.
preconditions: Singular role has an active holder in the applicable scope.
action_or_input: Activate that role for a second user in that scope.
expected_result: Second overlapping active assignment is rejected.

purpose: Require a start date for every role assignment.
action_or_input: Submit a role assignment without a start date.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected.

purpose: Require an end date for time-bound roles.
action_or_input: Submit a time-bound assignment with a start date but no end date.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected.

source_id: BR-SA-008 permanent role may omit end date
purpose: Permit permanent roles to omit an end date.
preconditions: Role is permanent.
action_or_input: Submit assignment with a start date and no end date.
expected_result: Assignment is not rejected for omitting the end date.

purpose: Activate a future-dated assignment automatically on its start date.
preconditions: Future-dated assignment exists; start date is reached.
action_or_input: Reach the configured start date without a separate Super Admin action.
expected_result: Role status and effective access update to active.

purpose: Inactivate a time-bound role automatically on its end date.
preconditions: Time-bound role is active; end date is reached; no earlier reassignment or revocation supersedes it.
action_or_input: Reach the configured end date.
expected_result: Role becomes inactive without a separate Super Admin action.

source_id: BR-SA-009 earlier reassignment or revocation supersedes scheduled end
purpose: Honor an earlier reassignment or revocation over the scheduled end.
preconditions: Assignment has a scheduled end; reassignment or revocation occurs earlier.
action_or_input: Reach the original scheduled end date.
expected_result: The superseded scheduled end does not override the earlier reassignment or revocation.

purpose: Allow assignment to a user type permitted by role metadata.
preconditions: User type is allowed by role metadata.
action_or_input: Assign the role to the user.
expected_result: Assignment is not rejected on eligibility grounds.

source_id: BR-SA-010 Student assigned Faculty or Staff role
purpose: Reject Faculty- or Staff-specific roles for a Student.
preconditions: Target is a Student; role is Faculty- or Staff-specific.
action_or_input: Assign the role to the Student.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected and eligibility conflict identified.

purpose: Reject assignments conflicting with role compatibility metadata.
preconditions: Proposed assignment conflicts by overlap or scope according to metadata.
action_or_input: Submit the assignment.
expected_result: Assignment is rejected and conflict reported.

purpose: Transfer work and access as one reassignment handover.
preconditions: Role has old holder, pending tasks or requests, and a reassignment effective date.
action_or_input: Reach the effective date.
expected_result: Pending work transfers; old access is removed; new access is granted; singular role has no two active holders during transfer.

purpose: Verify emergency reassignment is immediate.
preconditions: Reassignment is designated emergency.
action_or_input: Submit emergency reassignment.
expected_result: Reassignment is immediate.

purpose: Limit previous holder to read-only access to their prior actions during the configured audit period.
preconditions: Role was reassigned; configured audit period applies; previous holder has prior actions.
action_or_input: Access prior actions and attempt a role-operational action as previous holder.
expected_result: Own prior actions are readable; role-operational authority is not retained.

purpose: Enforce at least one day's notice for standard revocation.
preconditions: Revocation is standard.
action_or_input: Schedule revocation with less than one day's notice.
expected_result: Standard revocation is not accepted with insufficient notice.

source_id: BR-SA-014 standard revocation reason and pending-task disposition
purpose: Require reason and pending-task disposition for revocation.
preconditions: Revocation is standard.
action_or_input: Submit revocation without a reason or without selecting transfer or close for pending tasks.
expected_result: Revocation is not accepted without required information.

purpose: Verify emergency revocation may be immediate.
preconditions: Revocation is designated emergency.
action_or_input: Submit emergency revocation without standard notice period.
expected_result: Revocation may be immediate.

source_id: BR-SA-014 effective-date access removal and task handling
purpose: Apply access removal and pending-task disposition at effective date.
preconditions: Revocation has a reason, task disposition, and effective date.
action_or_input: Reach effective date.
expected_result: Access is removed and tasks are transferred or closed as selected.

purpose: Automatically revoke role when validity expires.
preconditions: Role end date is reached.
action_or_input: Reach role end date.
expected_result: Effective access is removed and history preserved.

purpose: Automatically revoke role when associated user is deactivated.
preconditions: User has an active role.
action_or_input: Deactivate user.
expected_result: Effective role access is removed and history preserved.

purpose: Send expiry reminder at configured lead time.
preconditions: Role has an end date; configured reminder lead time is reached.
action_or_input: Reach the configured lead time before expiry.
expected_result: Expiry reminder is sent.

source_id: BR-SA-016 extension requires new end date and reason
purpose: Reject extension missing new end date or reason.
preconditions: Role is eligible for extension.
action_or_input: Submit extension missing either new end date or reason.
expected_result: Extension is rejected and history preserved.

purpose: Accept extension with new end date and reason.
preconditions: Role is eligible for extension.
action_or_input: Submit extension with new end date and reason.
expected_result: Extension is accepted and history preserved.

purpose: Allow archival when historical data meets all eligibility checks.
preconditions: Retention age met; cycle or transaction complete with no pending action; required archival marking and dependency checks satisfied.
action_or_input: Submit archival request.
expected_result: Data is eligible for archival.

source_id: BR-SA-017 ineligible historical data and audit-log exclusion
purpose: Exclude ineligible records and audit logs from archival.
preconditions: Requested data includes a record failing an eligibility check and includes audit logs.
action_or_input: Submit archival request.
expected_result: Ineligible records are excluded with dependencies or blocks reported; audit logs are excluded.

purpose: Create backup before moving historical data to archive database.
preconditions: Archival confirmed; backup can complete.
action_or_input: Execute archival.
expected_result: Backup is created before data movement.

purpose: Abort archival if required backup cannot complete.
preconditions: Archival confirmed; required backup cannot complete.
action_or_input: Execute archival.
expected_result: Archival aborts and data is not moved.

purpose: Prevent purge before applicable retention period elapses.
preconditions: Archived data is within institutional and module-specific retention period.
action_or_input: Attempt purge.
expected_result: Data is not purged.

source_id: BR-SA-020 archive read-only access and isolation
purpose: Keep archive interface read-only and enforce data isolation.
preconditions: Archived records include permitted metadata and operational content.
action_or_input: Search or retrieve records, attempt archive-interface edit, and request module-specific content.
expected_result: Permitted search and retrieval work; editing is denied; unauthorized module content is not exposed.

purpose: Reject purge before retention expires.
preconditions: Applicable retention period has not elapsed.
action_or_input: Request permanent purge.
expected_result: Request is rejected.

purpose: Permit purge request to proceed to authorization after retention expires.
preconditions: Applicable retention period has elapsed.
action_or_input: Request permanent purge.
expected_result: Request is not rejected on retention eligibility grounds; authorization remains required.

purpose: Execute eligible purge with Super Admin request and IT Head approval.
preconditions: Data is purge-eligible; Super Admin request submitted; IT Head approval recorded.
action_or_input: Execute purge.
expected_result: Permanent purge is executed.

source_id: BR-SA-022 IT Head approval absent or rejected
purpose: Keep data archived without IT Head approval or after rejection.
preconditions: Super Admin requested purge; IT Head approval is absent or rejected.
action_or_input: Attempt purge.
expected_result: Purge does not execute and data remains archived.

purpose: Deliver assignment notification within one hour of effective operation.
preconditions: Role assignment becomes effective.
action_or_input: Observe notification delivery time.
expected_result: Affected users receive notification within one hour.

purpose: Deliver revocation notification within one hour of effective operation.
preconditions: Role revocation becomes effective.
action_or_input: Observe notification delivery time.
expected_result: Affected users receive notification within one hour.

source_id: BR-SA-024 failed login logging below threshold
purpose: Log failures and verify alert threshold is not reached before five consecutive failures.
preconditions: No successful login interrupts the sequence.
action_or_input: Submit four consecutive failed logins.
expected_result: Each failure is logged; five-failure alert has not yet triggered.

source_id: BR-SA-024 five consecutive failed login threshold and channels
purpose: Trigger alert at five consecutive failures through configured critical-alert channels.
preconditions: No successful login interrupts the sequence; critical-alert channels are configured.
action_or_input: Submit the fifth consecutive failed login.
expected_result: Security alert triggers and uses configured critical-alert channels.

purpose: Use SMS for critical alert when configured.
preconditions: SMS is enabled in configured critical-alert channels.
action_or_input: Trigger a critical security alert.
expected_result: Alert uses configured channels, including SMS when enabled.

source_id: BR-SA-025 audit immutability and permanent retention
purpose: Verify audit logs cannot be modified or deleted and are retained permanently.
preconditions: An audit entry exists.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify and delete it, then inspect retention.
expected_result: Modification and deletion are prevented; entry remains permanently available.

purpose: Preserve role-assignment history after expiry.
preconditions: A role assignment has expired.
action_or_input: Inspect role-assignment history.
expected_result: History remains available.

purpose: Allow Super Admin access to specified identity, role, audit, activity-metadata, and archive-management data/functions.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: View user identification/profile, role information, audit logs, activity metadata, and archive-management functions.
expected_result: Specified permitted data and functions are accessible.

purpose: Prevent exposure of prohibited operational content.
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; such content exists.
action_or_input: Request grades, financial details, medical or complaint content, requests or approvals, documents, and submissions through views, reports, archival, or handovers.
expected_result: Module-specific operational content is not exposed.

source_id: BR-SA-027 strong password and mandatory two-factor authentication
purpose: Enforce strong-password policy and mandatory two-factor authentication.
preconditions: Super Admin account exists.
action_or_input: Attempt login using a noncompliant password or without completing two-factor authentication.
expected_result: Access is denied when either mandatory control is not met.

source_id: BR-SA-027 one active Super Admin session
purpose: Permit only one active Super Admin session.
preconditions: Super Admin has an active session.
action_or_input: Attempt to establish another active session.
expected_result: A second active Super Admin session is not permitted.

source_id: BR-SA-027 inactivity timeout and session activity logging
purpose: Enforce configured inactivity timeout and log session activity.
preconditions: Session is active; configured timeout is known.
action_or_input: Remain inactive until timeout and inspect session activity logs.
expected_result: Session is terminated at configured timeout and activity is logged.

purpose: Enforce IP whitelist when enabled.
preconditions: Whitelist enforcement enabled; login source is not whitelisted.
action_or_input: Attempt Super Admin login.
expected_result: Access is denied.

source_id: BR-SA-028 no self-modification of Super Admin status
purpose: Reject in-module self-assignment or modification of Super Admin status.
preconditions: Actor is a Super Admin.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign or modify own Super Admin status through module.
expected_result: Operation is rejected; no in-module Super Admin assignment use case is provided.

source_id: BR-SA-029 critical operation without successful reauthentication
purpose: Prevent critical operation without successful confirmation and authentication.
preconditions: Operation is designated critical by policy.
action_or_input: Attempt operation without successful confirmation and authentication.
expected_result: Operation does not execute.

source_id: BR-SA-029 critical operation with successful reauthentication
purpose: Allow critical operation to proceed after successful confirmation and authentication.
preconditions: Operation is designated critical by policy; confirmation and authentication succeed.
action_or_input: Execute the operation.
expected_result: Operation may execute subject to other applicable rules.

purpose: Accept operation at the maximum record limit.
action_or_input: Submit a bulk operation with 1000 records.
expected_result: It is not rejected for exceeding the limit.

purpose: Reject or require partitioning above the maximum record limit.
action_or_input: Submit one bulk operation with 1001 records.
expected_result: Operation is rejected or partitioning is required.

purpose: Require password change at configured rotation interval.
preconditions: Password age has reached configured rotation interval.
action_or_input: Attempt Super Admin authentication.
expected_result: Password change is required according to configured policy.

source_id: BR-SA-032 configured email and in-system channels
purpose: Dispatch supported notifications through configured email and in-system channels.
preconditions: A supported notification event occurs; email and in-system notifications are configured.
action_or_input: Trigger the event.
expected_result: Notification is dispatched through configured channels appropriate to the event.

source_id: BR-SA-032 optional SMS for critical security alert
purpose: Support SMS as an optional configured critical-alert channel.
preconditions: Critical security alert occurs; SMS is enabled.
action_or_input: Trigger the alert.
expected_result: Alert uses configured channels, including SMS when enabled.

source_id: BR-SA-033 audit event coverage and record content
purpose: Verify required audit event categories and applicable record fields.
preconditions: Module permits listed user, role, authentication, archival, and configuration events.
action_or_input: Perform user creation/profile/status changes; role assignment/reassignment/revocation; login/logout and failed login; archival; and permitted configuration changes. Inspect entries.
expected_result: Every listed category creates an entry with timestamp, actor identifier, action, target user/role where applicable, IP address, result, and available context/reason; fields genuinely not applicable may be absent only as allowed by the PS.

source_id: BR-SA-034 select currently assigned active role
purpose: Accept selection of a role currently assigned and active for the user.
preconditions: Role is currently assigned and active for the user.
action_or_input: Select role as active-role context and request module access.
expected_result: Selection is accepted and that role's permissions govern access.

source_id: BR-SA-034 inactive, expired, revoked, historical, or unassigned role
purpose: Deny role selection or access using a role that is not currently assigned and active.
preconditions: Role is unassigned, inactive, expired, revoked, or merely historical.
action_or_input: Select the role or request module access through it.
expected_result: Role does not grant effective access.

source_id: BR-SA-034 selected active role permission enforcement
purpose: Enforce only permissions of the selected active role.
preconditions: User has multiple active assigned roles with distinct permissions; one role is selected.
action_or_input: Request access allowed by an unselected role but not by the selected role.
expected_result: Access is denied; permissions from unselected roles are not implicitly combined.

source_id: BR-SA-035 permitted configuration within policy bounds
purpose: Allow permitted configuration categories within policy bounds.
preconditions: Change concerns password policy, session timeout, archival retention, notification preferences, or bulk-operation limits; value is within policy bounds.
action_or_input: Submit configuration change.
expected_result: Change is allowed.

purpose: Reject configuration changes outside Super Admin authority.
action_or_input: Attempt to change module-specific configuration, academic calendars/schedules, financial rules/policies, or operational module workflows.
expected_result: Change is rejected.

source_id: BR-SA-035 archival retention outside institutional policy limits
purpose: Reject archival retention value outside institutional policy limits.
preconditions: Proposed retention value is outside institutional policy limits.
action_or_input: Submit archival retention configuration change.
expected_result: Change is rejected.
